name: hold-to-confirm
title: Hold to Confirm
description: A deliberate press-and-hold control for consequential actions, with cancellable progress.

accessibility.notes: Pointer and touch users hold and may cancel immediately. Keyboard, assistive technology, and programmatic activation use a clearly labelled two-step native click path. Blur, disabled state, visibility loss, and unmount cancel pending timers; ordinary capture release preserves confirmed feedback.

performance.budget: One confirmation timer while held and one short status timer after success; both are cleared on every interruption path.
